topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and sets the clinical and biological context of the course.

topics.label: Cellular, genetic, and architectural basis of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the fundamental concept of cancer as a progressive failure of cellular differentiation, genetic regulation, and three-dimensional tissue architecture.

topics.label: Benign versus malignant tumor characteristics, invasion, and progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the pathological differences between benign and malignant tumors, focusing on mechanisms of local invasion, metastatic dissemination, and stepwise histological progression.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and classification rules
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and exceptions used to name benign and malignant tumors according to their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Pathophysiological causes of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the local, systemic, and metastatic mechanisms through which tumors cause clinical illness and death in patients.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across taxa
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine patterns of cancer frequency across human populations and other multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss typical clinical symptoms of cancer and evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of various screening modalities for detecting early lesions.

topics.label: Lecture closing and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic reviews the learning outcomes and provides logistical information for practical sessions and upcoming lectures.
